name: MultiPlaneNeRF
definition: A NeRF model that uses non-trainable representations of 3D objects by projecting 3D points onto 2D images. It solves the problems of long training times and poor generalization to unseen data found in vanilla NeRF.
summary: MultiPlaneNeRF replaces NeRF's object-specific weights with a shared decoder and 2D image features, enabling fast training and generalization to unseen objects.
